messages:
alex: Heads up — scheduling a maintenance window in eu-west5 tomorrow 02:00-05:00 UTC to rebalance GPU density across two pools (gpu-high, gpu-burst). We need rolling reboots for 40 nodes to apply NIC fw v2.4 and a small thermal-density tweak.

maya: Can we do 10-node batches? Last time 20 made backfill slow.

chen: +1 on 10. Also will pre-warm prefix cache and KV cache before shifting traffic.

sam: Cost note — some workloads will fall back to spot for ~3h during swaps. Rough estimate +$1.2k for the window. Need approval from finance or cc tag.

alex: We'll avoid spot for latency-sensitive routes. @chen can you pin those routes to reserved?

chen: Yep. I'll add a scheduler label and a rolling strategy. Example snippet: 
```
kubectl label nodes -l pool=gpu-high latency=high
cat > rollout.yaml <<EOF
strategy: rolling
batchSize: 10
fallback: reserved
EOF
kubectl apply -f rollout.yaml
```

maya: @oncall-sre any Dedicated pool constraints? We should not touch customer-dedicated.

oncall-sre: Dedicated pools unaffected. Ensure warmup script runs 15m before first batch. I'll monitor.

infra-bot: Deploy window created: id=maint-eu5-2026-03-22T02Z, ETA=2026-03-22T02:00Z, nodes=40, batches=10, owner=alex.

alex: FYI — NIC fw v2.4 can regress under sustained 80% egress in specific NIC microcode combos. Thermal sim shows transient packet drops if racks are rebooted contiguously. We'll stagger across racks.

sam: Fallback capacity — can we cross-route non-critical traffic to eu-west3 during batches? Estimated latency penalty ~20ms, cost +3%.

maya: Yes, route non-critical traffic. Also please prepare the customer advisory. Template below: 
```
Hi Support — maintenance eu-west5 02:00-05:00 UTC. Non-critical traffic will be routed to eu-west3 temporarily. No Dedicated pools impacted. Expect slight latency increase and short retryable errors.
```

alex: Post-rollout smoke tests: run 50 small inference calls + 20 embedding calls, verify p95 latency and token cost delta <5%. Script: `scripts/smoke/eu5_post_rollout.sh`

chen: Timeline: prewarm cache 01:40, batch1 start 02:00, each batch drain+warm ~8m, batches=4 -> last batch done ~03:52, cooldown and verification ~04:20.

sam: Approved on cost for this window. Tag costs: `cc:infra-ops`. :thumbsup:

maya: I'll post an advisory to #support and ping sales for any high-traffic customers. Also setting a short pager from 03:00-04:00 for latency spike watch.

oncall-sre: I'll shadow the dashboards and be available in thread. Will escalate if p95 > target or error rate >1%.

alex: Runbook + playbook will be uploaded here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eu-west5-density-rebalance — includes rollback steps, `kubectl drain` flags, and cache warmup commands.

chen: Quick cache warmup command to run ~20m before first batch: `curl -s http://prefix-cache.internal/warm?pool=gpu-high` and check `curl http://prefix-cache.internal/metrics | grep warmed_nodes`.

maya: Thanks all — will send final calendar invite and customer advisory in ~2h. :white_check_mark:
